Greenbrier Elects Emanuel Pearlman to Board of Directors


LAKE OSWEGO, Ore.


, Oct. 26, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- The Greenbrier Companies, Inc. (NYSE: GBX) ("Greenbrier"), a leading international supplier of equipment and services to global freight transportation markets, today announced that its Board of Directors (the "Board") has elected Emanuel (Manny) Pearlman as a Class III director, effective October 27, 2026. Mr. Pearlman will stand for election to the Greenbrier Board at the 2027 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The election of Mr. Pearlman is part of a cooperation agreement with Atlas Holdings and increases Greenbrier's Board to 11 members.


"As we advance our strategy to drive operational execution, commercial performance and enhanced through-cycle results, Manny's extensive experience in investment management and capital markets, and deep financial expertise bring valuable perspective to the Board," said Admiral Thomas B. Fargo (USN Retired), Greenbrier's Board Chair and Independent Director. "Greenbrier's meaningful global demand and expanding market reach establish a strong foundation that supports shareholder value creation."


In connection with the cooperation agreement, Atlas entered into a confidentiality agreement with Greenbrier, including customary standstill commitments, among other provisions.


**About Manny Pearlman**


Mr. Pearlman is an accomplished corporate governance professional with more than 35 years of experience spanning investment management, executive finance, operations and advisory positions with publicly traded and private companies.


Mr. Pearlman is the Founder, Chair and Chief Executive Officer of Liberation Investment Group, LLC, an investment management and consulting firm that provides financial consulting, capital-structure advice and support for IPOs, acquisitions, mergers, restructurings and other complex financial matters. He brings extensive business leadership and financial advisory experience to Greenbrier through his public- and private-company board service, as well as his service on audit, compensation, finance and nominating and governance committees. He currently serves on the board of MidCap Financial Investment Corporation, a publicly traded business development company.


Mr. Pearlman holds an AB in economics from Duke University and an MBA from Harvard Business School.


**About Greenbrier**


Greenbrier, headquartered in Lake Oswego, Oregon, is a leading international supplier of equipment and services to global freight transportation markets. Through its wholly-owned subsidiaries and joint ventures, Greenbrier designs, builds and markets freight railcars in North America, Europe, and Brazil. We are a leading provider of freight railcar wheel services, parts, maintenance and retrofitting services in North America. Greenbrier owns a lease fleet of approximately 20,900 railcars that originate primarily from Greenbrier's manufacturing operations. Greenbrier offers railcar management, regulatory compliance services and leasing services to railroads and other railcar owners in North America.
